register_dataset: register a dataset function in DatasetCatalog with a name and callable that returns dataset samples
get_dataset_annotations: get dataset annotations from DatasetCatalog by name, calling the registered function to return list of dicts
list_registered_datasets: list all registered dataset names from DatasetCatalog
set_dataset_metadata: set metadata attributes like thing_classes on a Metadata instance via MetadataCatalog.get
get_metadata_attribute: get a metadata attribute from MetadataCatalog.get with a default fallback if the key does not exist
